home.reactionDesc: Tap the moment it turns green
home.reactionHelp: Wait for the background to turn green, then tap immediately. Early taps don't count. 5 valid taps — your score is the median, so one fumble won't wreck it.
home.numberMemoryHelp: Memorize the digits shown and type them back. Each success adds one digit, until you miss.
home.sequenceHelp: Tiles light up one by one. Remember the order and click them back in the same sequence. Each success adds one step, until you miss.
home.stroopHelp: A color word appears, printed in a different color. Ignore the word's meaning and pick the ink color. As many correct picks as possible in 60 seconds — wrong picks lose points.
home.mathSprintHelp: Answer as many problems as you can in 60 seconds. Correct answers auto-advance and the difficulty ramps up.

instruction.title: Help & Instructions
instruction.subtitle: Understand N-Back training and the system

nback.title: N-Back Mechanism
nback.intro: N-Back is a classic working memory training method. You need to recall information from N rounds ago and respond in the current round. The higher the N, the greater the challenge.
nback.exampleHint: 1-Back = recall 1 round ago;  2-Back = recall 2 rounds ago, and so on

modes.numeric: Delayed recall of equation answers, training working memory and math
modes.spatial: Remember highlighted grid positions, training spatial memory and observation
modes.mouse: Track final mouse positions after cats push them around
modes.house: Track enter/leave (including concurrent), report final head count

rank.title: Brain Rank LV1-LV7
rank.desc: Accumulate XP through training to advance ranks. Each session earns XP based on N-level, accuracy, and rounds.

radar.title: Six-Dimension Brain Radar
radar.desc: The radar chart displays your overall cognitive ability across six dimensions. Each dimension is driven by different training modes and performance metrics.

memory.name: Memory
memory.desc: Based on your highest N-Back level achieved, reflecting working memory capacity

focus.name: Focus
focus.desc: Based on average accuracy from your last 20 sessions

math.name: Math
math.desc: Performance in Numeric Flow mode, reflecting mental math speed and accuracy

observation.name: Observation
observation.desc: Performance in Spatial Flow and Devilish Mice modes

loadCapacity.name: Load Capacity
loadCapacity.desc: Combined performance in House Flow and high-level N-Back

reaction.name: Reaction
reaction.desc: Based on average reaction time (faster = higher)

energy.title: Energy System
energy.desc1: Each training session costs 1 energy. Maximum energy is 5.
energy.desc2: Energy recovers 1 point every 4 hours automatically.
energy.desc3: You can also purchase Energy Potions in the store for instant recovery.

gameLanding.faqAccountA: No. Just open a game and play — your progress is saved locally in your browser, no sign-up required.

gameLanding.reactionSub: 5-tap series · score is your median · Space works too

reaction.1: This test measures simple visual reaction time: the pad turns green after a random delay, and your tap latency is recorded. Your score is the median of 5 valid taps, so a single fumble won't wreck it.
reaction.2: Scores depend on your device and input method — a gaming mouse and a touchscreen report differently, so compare against the typical value in spirit only. Everything runs and stays in your browser: no account, no data leaving this device.
reaction.source: typical value source: humanbenchmark.com public statistics (median of ≈81M samples), read Nov 2026 · not a percentile, not a cognitive score
